dedupe_keys.name: data set for neural network based digital predistortion for active antenna arrays under load modulation

description: Alberto Brihuega and collaborators publish transmitted and received I/Q observations for beam-dependent load modulation in a millimetre-wave active array. The June 2020 Zenodo ZIP and MATLAB visualisation script are freely available under CC BY 4.0. Measurements use an Anokiwave AWMF-0129 array with sixty-four active elements at 28 GHz, transmitting a 200 MHz OFDM waveform. The description specifies a 4096-point FFT, 3168 active subcarriers, sixty-kilohertz subcarrier spacing and fivefold oversampling. Received signals correspond to different electronic steering directions. These paired signals can calibrate nonlinear transmitter and predistortion models in communication-system simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. Exact beam angles, sample counts, observation dates, internal signal encoding and measurement uncertainty remain unknown from the landing page. One hardware array does not represent all radio front ends. The archive was not downloaded or its reported algorithms executed.
